deadlines.label: Capital grant application deadline (for a mid-June decision); moves to next business day if on a weekend or holiday
deadlines.quote: Application deadline: March 15, 2027, 5:00 p.m. (annual deadlines March 15 and September 1; applications accepted any time)

deadlines.label: Annual September 1 deadline at 5:00 p.m. (for a mid-December decision); year not stated
deadlines.quote: September 1 at 5:00 p.m. (for a mid-December decision; NOTE this is changed from previous deadline of Sept. 15)

criteria.name: Projects that address root problems with substantive solutions
criteria.quote: When making funding decisions, we prioritize: Projects that address root problems with substantive solutions

criteria.name: Evidence of community involvement and support
criteria.quote: Projects with evidence of community involvement in setting project priorities

criteria.name: Projects in rural and low-income areas
criteria.quote: Projects in rural and low-income areas across Colorado where there are fewer individuals and institutions providing support for capital projects

criteria.name: Projects that serve individuals and communities of color
criteria.quote: Projects that serve individuals and communities of color who have faced historic inequities and lack of access to funding

criteria.name: Engagement and financial support from the governing board
criteria.quote: Projects with strong engagement and financial support from the organization’s governing board

criteria.name: Reinforces the foundation's strategic priorities
criteria.quote: Projects that reinforce the foundation’s strategic priorities in K-12 public education, natural resources, community development, and informed communities

criteria.name: Climate change, green building and sustainable development practices
criteria.quote: Projects that address climate change, and/or incorporate green building and sustainable development practices

criteria.name: Sound management, effective leadership and engaged board
criteria.quote: Organizations with sound management practices, effective executive leaders, and engaged board members

other: Submit the completed Colorado Common Capital Grant Application by email to grants@gatesfamilyfoundation.org, or by mail or delivery to 1390 Lawrence Street, Suite 400, Denver, CO 80204
format.quote: Please send completed grant applications by email to grants@gatesfamilyfoundation.org, or by mail or delivery to 1390 Lawrence Street, Suite 400, Denver, CO 80204.

eligibility.item: Applicant must be a 501(c)(3) tax-exempt public charity under section 509(a)(1) or 509(a)(2), able to document tax-exempt status issued within the last five years
eligibility.quote: Be classified by the Internal Revenue Service as tax-exempt under section 501(c)(3) of the Internal Revenue Code (the “Code”), classified as a public charity under section 509(a)(1) or 509(a)(2) of the Code, and be able to provide documentation of tax-exempt status issued within the last five years.

eligibility.item: Governmental entities are considered only in limited circumstances
eligibility.quote: In limited circumstances, the Foundation also considers grant requests from governmental entities.

eligibility.item: Must provide services benefiting the state of Colorado and its citizens
eligibility.quote: Provide services benefiting the state of Colorado and its citizens.

eligibility.item: Commitments for approximately 30% of the funds needed to complete the project must be in place before submission, unless waived
eligibility.quote: Have commitments for approximately 30% of the funds needed to complete the project in place prior to submission, unless a waiver of this requirement has been granted.

eligibility.item: Capital grants are generally limited to comprehensive capital campaigns (building purchase, construction, expansion, renovation, land acquisition)
eligibility.quote: Our capital grants are generally limited to comprehensive capital campaigns, which are typically for building purchases, construction, expansion, renovation, and/or land acquisition.

eligibility.item: Generally no more than one proposal per organization per calendar year; previously denied proposals are not reconsidered
eligibility.quote: Consider more than one proposal from an organization in a calendar year unless initiated by the Foundation, and does not reconsider previously denied proposals.

eligibility.item: Generally no funding for projects substantially completed before the next trustees' meeting
eligibility.quote: Grant funds for projects that have been substantially completed prior to the next trustees’ meeting.

eligibility.item: Generally no funding for general operating or program expenses unless initiated by the Foundation
eligibility.quote: Grant funds for general operating or program expenses unless initiated by the Foundation.

eligibility.item: Generally no funding to retire operating or construction debt
eligibility.quote: Grant funds to retire operating or construction debt.

eligibility.item: Generally no funding for vehicles, or for office or computer equipment unless part of a comprehensive capital campaign
eligibility.quote: Grant funds for the purchase of vehicles. Grant funds to purchase office or computer equipment unless they are part of a comprehensive capital campaign.

eligibility.item: Generally no grants directly to individual public schools or public school districts unless initiated by the Foundation; P-12 private schools, district-owned facilities and higher education facilities or campaigns generally not supported
eligibility.quote: We generally do not support P-12 private schools or district-owned facilities, or higher education facilities or capital campaigns

eligibility.item: Generally no grants to private foundations or grantmaking organizations, to foreign organizations, or to individuals
eligibility.quote: Grant funds to other private foundations or organizations engaged in grant making.

eligibility.item: Generally no grants to 509(a)(3) supporting organizations other than Type I, Type II or functionally-integrated Type III not controlled by a disqualified person
eligibility.quote: Grant funds to supporting organizations described in section 509(a)(3), other than a Type I, Type II or functionally-integrated Type III supporting organization

eligibility.item: Generally no support for religious organizations or activities; faith-based organizations funded only if they serve and welcome all and do not require religious participation
eligibility.quote: We only fund faith-based organizations that serve and welcome all individuals, and do not require participation in religious activities

eligibility.item: Generally no funding for medical research or construction of major medical facilities; mental and behavioral treatment facilities for adults, senior care and hospice facilities are not funded
eligibility.quote: We do not fund mental and behavioral treatment facilities for adults; senior care facilities; or hospice facilities

eligibility.item: Animal service or animal welfare organizations are not funded
eligibility.quote: We do not fund animal service or animal welfare organizations

eligibility.item: Generally no funding for conferences, meetings or studies, fundraising event tickets, or political or lobbying activities
eligibility.quote: Grant funds for conferences, meetings, or studies that are not initiated by the Foundation.

requiredDocuments.quote: The Gates Family Foundation accepts the Colorado Common Capital Grant Application for all capital grant requests.

requiredDocuments.item: Documentation of tax-exempt status issued within the last five years
requiredDocuments.quote: be able to provide documentation of tax-exempt status issued within the last five years.
